_meta.notes: Comprehensive index of all thematic clusters (Level 4) and sub-clusters (Level 5) for Nauru.

910.name: Early Settlement of Nauru
910.description: Micronesian and Polynesian peoples settle Nauru; twelve-tribe system.

sub_clusters.name: Twelve Tribes of Nauru
sub_clusters.description: Twelve clans form foundation of Nauruan society; represented in national flag's 12-pointed star.

920.name: Pre-Contact Nauruan Society
920.description: Isolated atoll society with unique language, aquaculture, and social structure.

sub_clusters.name: Buada Lagoon Aquaculture
sub_clusters.description: Milkfish cultivation in Buada Lagoon; unique Pacific aquaculture tradition.

sub_clusters.name: Matrilineal Social System
sub_clusters.description: Matrilineal descent; temonibe (chiefs); complex land tenure.

930.name: European Contact Period
930.description: Whaler contact; introduction of firearms sparks decade-long civil war.

sub_clusters.name: First European Contact
sub_clusters.description: British Captain John Fearn names it 'Pleasant Island'.

sub_clusters.name: Nauruan Tribal War
sub_clusters.description: Firearms from traders escalate tribal conflicts; population drops from 1,400 to 900.

940.name: German Colonial Period
940.description: German annexation; peace imposed; phosphate discovered.

sub_clusters.name: German Annexation
sub_clusters.description: Germany annexes Nauru as part of Marshall Islands protectorate; disarmament.

sub_clusters.name: Phosphate Discovery
sub_clusters.description: Albert Ellis identifies phosphate deposits; Pacific Phosphate Company begins mining.

sub_clusters.name: British Phosphate Commissioners
sub_clusters.description: UK, Australia, NZ jointly exploit phosphate; 80% of island surface strip-mined.

950.name: World War II — Japanese Occupation
950.description: Japanese occupation; deportation of Nauruans to Truk; devastation.

sub_clusters.name: Japanese Occupation
sub_clusters.description: Airfield construction; 1,200 Nauruans deported to Chuuk; many perish.

sub_clusters.name: Liberation and Return
sub_clusters.description: Survivors repatriated; only 737 Nauruans remain; population decimated.

950.name: Independence and Phosphate Wealth
950.description: Independence; brief period as highest GDP per capita on Earth.

sub_clusters.name: Nauru Independence (1968)
sub_clusters.description: Independence 31 January 1968; Hammer DeRoburt first president.

sub_clusters.name: Phosphate Wealth Era
sub_clusters.description: Highest per capita income globally; Nauru Phosphate Royalties Trust mismanaged.

960.name: Post-Phosphate Economic Crisis
960.description: Phosphate exhaustion; economic collapse; desperate financial schemes.

sub_clusters.name: Economic Collapse
sub_clusters.description: Phosphate depleted; trust fund squandered; near-bankruptcy.

sub_clusters.name: Money Laundering and Passport Sales
sub_clusters.description: Shell banks; Russian money laundering; FATF blacklisting.

960.name: Australian Offshore Detention
960.description: Nauru hosts Australian asylum seeker processing centre; Pacific Solution.

sub_clusters.name: Pacific Solution (2001–2008)
sub_clusters.description: Howard government sends asylum seekers to Nauru; Tampa affair.

sub_clusters.name: Regional Processing Centre (2012–present)
sub_clusters.description: Reopened under Gillard government; human rights concerns; economic lifeline.
